hints.title: Monotonic Increasing Order
hints.text: To make the subsequence competitive, earlier elements should be as small as possible.

hints.title: Remaining Elements Quota
hints.text: You may pop a larger element from the stack only if remaining elements in the array plus stack size exceeds k.

hints.title: Slice to Exactly Length K
hints.text: Push current element if stack has room, and return the first k elements of the stack.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n choose k subsequences takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack runs in linear O(n) time and O(k) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly enforces the capacity invariant: len(stack) + (n - i) > k when popping.
